description: The fast way to add supports, point springs, beam end releases, self-weight, nodal loads, beam UDLs, plate pressures and element temperatures: describe WHERE (structure group, id ranges, a line, a box, a coordinate, or the extreme nodes of a group) and WHAT, and the tool finds the nodes / elements and builds the CONS, CNLD, BMLD and PRES rows itself — no table lookup, no reading NODE / ELEM, no rows to write. Values are in kN and m by default (units: { force, length }) and converted to the model's units; signs follow the global axes (w: -10 with dir GZ = 10 kN/m downward). Missing load cases (STLD), load groups and boundary groups are created. Examples: supports [{ at: { group: "GIRDERS", pick: "xmin" }, type: "pinned" }, { at: { group: "GIRDERS", pick: "xmax" }, type: "roller-x" }]; udl [{ on: { group: "GIRDERS" }, case: "SIDL", w: -12.5 }]; udl with range { axis: "x", from: 10, to: 20 } loads only that stretch; nodalLoads [{ at: { nodes: "101to121by2" }, case: "Wheel", F: [0, 0, -50] }]; pressure [{ on: { group: "DECK" }, case: "Surfacing", p: -2.4 }]; springs [{ at: { group: "PIERS", pick: "zmin" }, k: [1e5, 1e5, 5e5] }]; releases [{ on: { group: "CROSS-BEAMS" }, free: "My Mz" }]; selfWeight [{ case: "SW" }]; temperature [{ on: { group: "DECK" }, case: "T+", uniform: 15, gradientZ: 10 }]. The preview is a summary — counts, ids, and total force per load case to check against the intended load. Apply with apply: true and confirmPlanHash; every row is read back. Undo with civil_write_tables_undo (same ledger). Rules kept for you: CIVIL NX keeps one nodal load per case per node, so loads landing on the same node and case are summed (also with an existing one, with a warning); an existing support on a node is replaced; existing beam loads and pressures are kept and the new ones added.

apply.description: Write to CIVIL NX. Only after the user approved the preview.

cases.description: Optional types for load cases this call creates: [{ name, type: D | DC | DW | L | W | T | USER … }].

confirmPlanHash.description: planHash from the approved preview; refused if the model or the inputs changed.

F.description: [FX, FY, FZ, MX, MY, MZ] per node, force and force×length.

at.description: Which nodes. Start set: group (structure group name), nodes, elements — given together they intersect; none = the whole model. Then filters (coordinates in the input length unit): line { from, to } (on that segment), box { min, max }, where { x: 0 } or { z: [0, 2] }, type (BEAM, TRUSS, PLATE…), pick xmin|xmax|ymin|ymax|zmin|zmax (the extreme nodes, e.g. the ends of a girder group). An element passes a geometric filter when all its nodes do. tol default 0.001.

case.description: Static load case name (≤ 40 characters); created if missing (type from cases[], default USER).

loadGroup.description: Optional load group name; created if missing.
